title: When the rest alert, the watch link, Health Connect or a Plus payment fails on a member's phone, MettleUp never hears of it
what: The phone's notification, watch, widget, Health Connect and payment parts catch their own failures and write them only to the phone's own log (well over 100 such lines in this area): a rest-over sound that is missing, an alert ring that did not play, a watch message not passed on, a workout not sent to Health Connect, a Play payment answer. The crash reports that do reach MettleUp only carry errors nothing caught and screens that crashed. So a rest alert that stays silent on one phone model, or Health Connect sending that stops for everyone, shows up only if a member writes in.
expected: The failures that break a promise to the member (rest alert, watch link, Health Connect sending, payment) are counted and sent to MettleUp the same way crash reports are, without personal data, so the owner sees them in his daily check.
who: every member; the owner, who cannot see the fault
how_often: whenever one of these parts fails
fix_line: Send a short, data-free note to MettleUp's crash inbox when a promised alert, watch link, Health Connect send or payment fails

title: A member on the GitHub copy of the app gets a watch app from Google Play that can never talk to their phone
what: The phone and the watch only talk when both apps carry the same signing key. The app's own notes say the GitHub copy of the phone app is signed with a different key from the Play copy, and the phone sends members to the watch's Play Store to install or update the watch app. So a member on the GitHub copy installs a Play watch app that never shows the workout and whose buttons never log. Nothing on screen says why, and the owner has no written note of which key goes with which copy.
expected: On the GitHub copy, the phone either offers a watch app signed with the same key or says plainly that the watch needs the Play Store copy of the phone app. Which key signs which copy is written down where the owner can find it.
who: members who installed the phone app from GitHub and own a watch
fix_line: Tell GitHub-copy members the watch needs the Play copy, and write down which key signs which copy

title: Android's notification settings say workout reminders are set in Profile, but they are set in Settings, Reminders
what: In the phone's own notification settings, the 'Workout reminders' kind reads 'On the days and at the time you chose in Profile'. The days and time are now on the Reminders page inside Settings (reached from Profile's gear), so a member looking on Profile does not find them.
expected: The line names the real place, for example 'chosen in MettleUp, Settings, Reminders'.
who: members who look up reminders in the phone's settings
fix_line: Change the line to name Settings, Reminders

title: A MettleUp Plus subscriber is told they can cancel in Google Play but the app gives no way to get there
what: The Plus page says 'You can cancel a monthly or yearly plan there any time' (in Google Play). The app's Play payment part can only show prices, buy and check what is owned; there is no button that opens the member's Google Play subscriptions page. Plus buying is still switched off.
expected: Before payments go live, the Plus page has a 'Manage or cancel in Google Play' button that opens the member's Play subscriptions page for MettleUp.
who: Plus subscribers, once payments go live
how_often: every time one wants to cancel
fix_line: Add a button that opens Google Play's subscriptions page for MettleUp
